reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it seems like a natural first step toward restoring power.
expectation: I expect to clear the panels so they can collect more sunlight, though other restart steps may still be needed.

alternatives.reason: Restarting the water line also serves the goal, but restoring the solar array seems useful first.

effect: The array now provides a restored solar supply, which can be connected at the restart controls.
reaction: The result was straightforward; I’m curious how the water line will be brought back online.
reason: Connecting the restored solar supply seems like a useful first step toward restarting the station’s services.
expectation: I expect the station to switch back to solar power, though the water line may still need a separate restart.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but I would connect the restored power supply first.

effect: The return plant is running again, but it will need weeks to replace propellant lost during the shutdown. The water line still needs attention.
reaction: I was surprised that some stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown.
reason: Restarting the drained water line is the only available combination and should help restore the remaining essential service.
expectation: I expect the line to be checked and brought back into service, though I don't know whether that will complete the goal.

effect: The heated exterior line is primed and water is flowing from the well to the cabin again, completing the chapter.
reaction: The sequence of heating, checking and priming the line made its restart satisfying to follow.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile: the explanation showed how heating and priming prepare it before the well inlet opens.

leastWorthwhile.text: Brushing the array was straightforward, but the result gave little detail beyond the restored supply.

surprise.text: I was surprised that stored propellant boiled away during the shutdown and would take weeks to replace.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; cleaning the array and restarting power and water all served the stated goal.

continue.text: Yes. The propellant loss leaves me curious about the wait for departure and what happens to the specimens.
